name: hypothetical-diff
description: Generalizes Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE) from static documents to universal Before/After diffs across any non-coding or coding domain—writing, difficult conversations, negotiation, learning & mental models, habits, policy counterfactuals, strategy, calendars, contracts, spreadsheets, and code. Simulates any scenario or rewrite in any user-set tone with interactive hunk mix-and-match.
suggestedPrompts: Simulate a hypothetical diff for this difficult conversation (script + subtext + their reaction) in a warm, unshakeable tone
Show me a Mental Model Diff (intuitive misconception vs. how it actually works) for this topic
Run a counterfactual diff comparing Option A vs Option B across my schedule, energy, and trade-offs
